name: Round sardinella
description: Round sardinella (Sardinella aurita), tracked as its own compartment by the source (mean biomass 8.6 t·km-2, catches ~139 000 t·yr-1 in the 1990s). A filter-feeding clupeid that grazes phytoplankton and zooplankton - and the single most important fish in the web, eaten by seabirds, marine mammals, both tuna groups, sharks, cephalopods and even demersal fish.
